BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat War Dragon Turba!!
Not here either...Argh!
J-just what is it doing?\nLooks like it's looking for something though...\nOh, whoa, oh nooo!!
No, no, no, oh my goshhhhh!!
Little trashy veggies? What the...
Gr...grr...\nAaaaaaarhhh!!
Ugh!\nUrghhhhhhh!!
You think a trashy veggie like you can beat me?
I never...I never thought I could.\nHowever...however!!
Ohh?!
Oh?! What?!
The Tree Deity Rod changed form and turned into\nTree Deity Sword!
Whaaat?!
D-did Muti just become a "Sproutling"?!\nI've always thought that he was the most timid one\namong us.
Whoa...Hm?!\nOh, whoa!
Ouch?! Wow, this sword is sharp everywhere.\nI can't even hold it.\nI don't think we can use it if it's like this.
Oh, my, my, we don't have time for this!!\nAnyway, we need to knock that thing down!!
Since your flower has bloomed,\nyou should help us too!\nBut don't do anything stupid!
Y-yes, ma'am!!
I never knew I had this kind of power...
We're lucky that we were able to see the growth\nof a young boy and witness the birth of a\n"Sproutling"...I knew he was no ordinary Eumano!
But who would expect Muti's sprouting to be the\nthird power to fill it...Anyway, this thing is\nhiltless...How are we supposed to hold it??
The appearance of the sword makes you almost\nforget about what the dragon was looking for\nearlier...It's bugging you...
Huh? Yeah, you're right.\nWhat was it looking for that it had to go so far\nas to destroy things like this??
I heard you beat the dragon.\nThank you very much.
The buildings have been quite badly damaged, but\nsince the dragon is gone, I think we can rebuild\nthem...
Hey, are you guys hiding something in this\nvillage?\nSome rare treasure maybe...?
Hm? No, there's nothing like that here...\nBut, the guy who first saw the dragon said that\nit was looking for the "Blessing Bearer"...
Here comes another weird term...\nSo do you have any idea about what it was talking\nabout?
No, I've also told the dragon that I didn't know\nanything about who it was looking for when it came\nto attack this village...
But then it accused me of lying and began to\ndestroy the village. Because of that, we had to\nevacuate the village...
Hmm, the "Blessing Bearer"...\nShouldn't we go back to the town and ask\nthe leader?
The buildings are so badly damaged here, I don't\nthink it's very comfortable to live here,\nisn't it?
Since we're going back to the town of Erva Tronc,\nwhy don't you come with us and ask them to let you\nstay there for a while?
The soldiers and I will talk to the leader about\nyour situation too.
Ooh, that would be great.\nI really appreciate that.
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing, let's return to Erva Tronc!
Explore Prime Ramus a little longer.
